name: mdpad
description: A self-hosted, real-time collaborative Markdown notes editor that stores notes as plain .md files.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && esbuild src/client/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --sourcemap --outdir=dist/public/js/client
